sections.heading: PROFILE SUMMARY
sections.text: HSE Officer with 4 years of experience in oil and gas field operations, specializing in risk assessment, permit-to-work systems, and incident investigation. Skilled in conducting site inspections, delivering safety inductions, and ensuring compliance with company and national HSE standards across multi-contractor sites.

items.title: HSE Officer | Petroleum Development Oman – Fahud
items.overview: HSE Officer supporting drilling and production operations across multi-contractor field sites.
bullets: Conduct daily site inspections to identify hazards and ensure compliance with PDO HSE standards and procedures.
Review and approve permit-to-work applications, verifying isolations and control measures before work begins.
Lead incident investigations and root cause analysis, recommending corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
Deliver safety inductions and toolbox talks to contractor crews on job-specific risks and controls.
Prepare weekly HSE performance reports and track closure of audit findings with site supervisors.

items.title: HSE Trainee | Oman LNG – Sur
items.overview: Trainee within the HSE department supporting plant safety programmes.
bullets: Assisted HSE officers with workplace inspections and documentation of unsafe acts and conditions.
Supported emergency drills and maintained records of participation and lessons learned.
Prepared HSE statistics and presentations for monthly safety committee meetings.
Participated in risk assessments for routine maintenance and shutdown activities.

items.degree: BACHELOR OF ENGINEERING IN CHEMICAL ENGINEERING

items.title: Volunteer | Oman Red Crescent Society – Muscat
bullets: Supported first aid awareness campaigns and community health events.
